title: Relativity / collaborators

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study

slide_intent: Represent intellectual work as shared contribution because invisible collaboration is otherwise easy to overlook.
strategic_value: A scientific diagram with participant labels can broaden Figma’s campaign beyond the visual arts.
demonstration: An illustrated space-time diagram on gray carries four colored names, tools and cyan editing controls inside a black border.
practical_value: Adapt the collaboration motif to an abstract subject through recognizable diagrams and named contributors.

content_islands.name: Diagram
content_islands.spec: Center the double cone and plane with time and space axes.

content_islands.name: Participants
content_islands.spec: Place Albert above, Emmy left, Marcel right and Michele below right, paired with tool symbols.

content_islands.name: Editing controls
content_islands.spec: Highlight lines and the lower ellipse with cyan points and handles.

reference_purposes.Expression: A scientific diagram receives the same participant labels and editing treatment as the art campaign.
reference_purposes.Intent: The source narrative describes using stories of how great things were made to challenge individual-genius myths.
